title: Degree-zero empty-tuple evaluation
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring, $F$ an internal-function presentation, $J$ a profinite group, $B$ a given bar diagram, and $M$ an equivariant internal module [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data]. Under the cochain conventions of [def-sfb-internal-cochain-coordinate-data] there is an internal isomorphism $z:C_B^0(M)\simeq M$ such that the evaluation of any section c over S, on any profinite T, f:T\to S and empty tuple, equals $f^*(z(c))$. This assertion concerns just the degree-zero term, without homogeneous coordinates or group restriction.

source.place: Tag 0DVG, section-continuous-group-cohomology, displayed bar differential. Internal sheaf adaptation of the coordinate calculation, written by an agent; not asserted verbatim by Stacks.

proof.text: Evaluate an internal-function family on the empty tuple at (S,id). Its restriction formula implies naturality in S; evaluation additivity and scalar compatibility prove linearity. Lift this section map to an internal module map by the fully faithful section-module functor.

source.place: Tag 0DVG, section-continuous-group-cohomology, displayed bar differential. Internal sheaf adaptation of the coordinate calculation, written by an agent; not asserted verbatim by Stacks.

proof.text: For an inverse on sections send m to the natural family (T,f,g) mapped to f* m. The parameter J^0 is terminal, so g is unique. Family naturality shows these maps are mutually inverse. The sectionwise bijectivity implies that the internal map is an isomorphism, by reflection of isomorphisms through the forgetful functors. Compose with the given degree-zero bar-term isomorphism; the same naturality identity gives the required evaluation formula.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_internalBarZeroEvaluation {A : Ring.{u}} (F : InternalFunctions A)
    (J : ProfiniteGrp.{u}) (B : BarDiagram (G := J) F) (M : Equivariant A J) :
    ∃ z : ((cochains B).obj M).X 0 ≅ M.module,
      ∀ (S : Profinite.{u}) (c : sections A (((cochains B).obj M).X 0) S)
        (T : Profinite.{u}) (f : T ⟶ S) (g : Fin 0 → C(T, J)),
        inhomogeneousCoordinateValue B M 0 S c T f g =
          M.module.X.obj.map f.op (z.hom.hom.hom.app (op S) c)
